fields.description: Issue features editorials and local political coverage including discussion of Miami city politics (including H. Leslie Quigg and recall procedures), proposed consolidation of city and county tax assessor functions and its impact on property assessments, and debate over water rate increases. Includes commentary on gambling and racetracks, a column criticizing an alleged police killing of a Black man, and reporting on civil-rights concerns raised by vagrancy arrests. National political commentary addresses a proposed $100-per-month pension plan attributed to Secretary of Labor Maurice J. Tobin and arguments about the welfare state. Also includes a claim by Princess Red Rock regarding federal funds for Seminoles, along with regular columns and extensive local advertising and entertainment listings.
